title: Gandantegchinlen Monastery
description: Visit Mongolia's Buddhist heartland, pay respects at the Megjid Janraisig statue, and soak in the calm of this historic monastery.

title: Bogd Khan Palace Museum
description: Explore the green palace of Mongolia's last king, the 8th Bogd Jebtsundamba Khutugtu, and its landmark historic architecture.

title: Choijin Lama Temple Museum
description: Admire a masterpiece of late 19th-century Tibeto-Mongolian architecture in the city center and walk through its living history.

title: National Museum of Mongolia
description: Discover Mongolia's imperial heritage from the Xiongnu era to the Great Mongol Empire through rare national treasures.

title: Sukhbaatar Square
description: Stand at the capital's central heart and check in beside the monument to Genghis Khan.

title: Zaisan Memorial
description: Take in a sweeping panorama of the capital from the hilltop and enjoy a coffee with the breeze.

title: National Amusement Park
description: Cycle and stroll through green parkland and enjoy a breath of fresh air in the city.

title: Narantuul Market
description: Experience Mongolia's largest open-air market and pick up essentials for your journey.

title: Genghis Khan Statue Complex
description: Climb to the top of the world's largest equestrian statue at Tsonjin Boldog and look out over the Tuul River valley.

title: Aryabal Meditation Temple
description: Hike up to this serene hilltop retreat in Terelj and climb the 108 steps to clear your mind.

title: Turtle Rock
description: Pose for photos beside this giant turtle-shaped rock sculpted by nature.

title: Queen's Gable Temple
description: Find the historic temple ruins dedicated to Queen Enkh-Amgalan, hidden in the Khentii forest.

title: Karakorum
description: Stand on the ruins of the ancient capital of the Mongol Empire and feel the depth of history beneath your feet.

title: Erdene Zuu Monastery
description: Tour Mongolia's earliest Buddhist monastery complex, ringed by 108 stupas.

title: Karakorum Museum
description: View rare artifacts from the Orkhon Valley UNESCO site and the ancient city of Karakorum.

title: Orkhon Valley
description: Ride through the cradle of nomadic civilization in this UNESCO-listed valley.

title: Red Waterfall
description: Brew a hand-poured coffee beside this scenic waterfall cascading over volcanic rock.

title: Tuvkhun Monastery
description: Hike to the secluded hilltop monastery where Zanabazar once created his masterpieces.

title: Khongoryn Els (Singing Dunes)
description: Climb the singing sand dunes and listen for the deep roar as sand slides down the slope.

title: Bayanzag (Flaming Cliffs)
description: Watch the sunset glow over the red sandstone cliffs where the world's first dinosaur eggs were found.

title: Yolyn Am (Vulture Gorge)
description: Walk through the narrow gorge where ice persists even in the Gobi heat and spot wild ibex.

title: White Stupa
description: Marvel at this chalk-white cliff formation that looks like a ruined city from afar.

title: Khermen Tsav
description: Venture into the Martian-like red canyon deep in the Gobi for an otherworldly expedition.

title: Lake Khuvsgul
description: Set up camp on the shore of Mongolia's blue pearl and brew your morning coffee by crystal-clear water.

title: Uran Dosh Mountain
description: Summit the distinctive flat-topped peak on Khuvsgul's western shore.

title: Darkhad Valley
description: Explore the taiga's blue basin woven with hundreds of lakes and rivers.

title: Terkhiin Tsagaan Lake
description: Rest by the shores of this volcanic crater lake and listen to birdsong on the water.

title: Khorgo Volcano
description: Walk the rim of an extinct volcano crater and take in its striking geological formations.

title: Taikhar Rock
description: Stand beside the legendary lone boulder rising from the open steppe.

title: Altai Tavan Bogd
description: Check in at the base camp for expeditions toward Khuiten Peak (4,374 m), Mongolia's highest point.

title: Potanin Glacier
description: Stand before Mongolia's largest permanent glacier and feel the raw power of the land.

title: Amarbayasgalant Monastery
description: Visit a masterpiece of Mongolian architecture in the scenic Iven Valley of Selenge province.

title: Burkhan Khaldun
description: Pay respects at the sacred mountain Genghis Khan venerated, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

title: Menengiin Tal (Menen Steppe)
description: Pause on one of the world's largest uninterrupted steppe plains stretching to the horizon in eastern Mongolia.
